scenario_enrichment.summary: Added source-safe scenario tying adaptive reuse and heritage conservation vocabulary to RA 10066 and specialized architectural services to SPP 203.
scenario_enrichment.scenario_excerpt: A city is considering converting an old cinema into a public cultural venue. A source-safe exam answer starts with RA 10066 vocabulary: adaptive reuse changes the use of a valuable building, structure, or site while conserving its engineering integrity and design authenticity; built heritage includes structures, settings, and landscapes with historical or cultural significance; conservation can combine preservation, restoration, reconstruction, protection, and adaptation. The professional-practice cue is to scope the work as specialized architectural service under SPP 203 when heritage conservation and planning are involved, rather than treating it as a simple decoration exercise or ordinary occupancy-label change.
